U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio says President Donald Trump is yet to decide on fresh military strikes against Iran, as Washington continues to pursue a diplomatic solution. Rubio says the U.S. is open to negotiations but maintains that Iran’s nuclear ambitions and its alleged attacks on commercial ships remain major security concerns. His remarks come amid stalled talks and warnings from Iran against further U.S. and Israeli strikes.
Thank you for watching our video!
